definition: Flux is a family of text-to-image and image-to-image models developed by Black Forest Labs (BFL), based in Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany.
details: Black Forest Labs was founded by former employees of Stability AI. As with other text-to-image models, Flux generates images from natural language descriptions, called prompts. In addition, some Flux models support editing images.
story: Picture walking through a crowd and instantly picking out a familiar face without reading a single name tag. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. Sight, for a machine, is a long climb from raw light to a name. That pixel-to-meaning climb is Flux (text-to-image model).
